title: Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions
exact_target: Must every Boolean threshold of a real multilinear degree-at-most-d polynomial on the uniform n-cube, with $sign(0)=1$ and $1\leq d\leq n$, have total influence at most $8d\surd n$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
